notes.title: Demo version updated
notes.notes:
🎉 The final build of Heroic Hop: A New Adventure Begins is now live on Steam! 🚀

We’ve officially uploaded the full version of the game to Steam and everything is ready behind the scenes. We’re now gearing up for launch between August and October 2025! 🍂

🕹️ This marks a major milestone — development is complete, and now it’s just a matter of time until you can dive in.

💚 Add Heroic Hop to your wishlist and be the first to know when it releases:
[🔗 Steam page link]

Thanks for being part of the journey. The adventure is almost here! 🐸✨
